name: agentsfleet
description: Fleet Delivery Control Plane — long-lived, event-driven autonomous workers (Fleets) scoped to a workspace.

operations.description: Start an active Fleet in the given workspace from its first message, which becomes its first turn. Body: message, operation_id, and optional model_ref and name. Returns the fleet_id used for subsequent operations; a retry with the same operation_id and body returns the same Fleet.

Partial update of a Fleet. Body fields are optional and presence-based: name (rename the instance), model_ref (the model its next run uses), http_egress and package_domains (its network; a signed-in person only, an API key is refused), and status ("archived" cancels its work and keeps its history; archived is terminal).
Hard-delete a Fleet in any status and cascade its history (turns, telemetry, sessions, approval gates, memory entries). Live work is cancelled first. Returns 204 on success.
Post a chat message to a running Fleet's loop.
List the Fleet's turn history with pagination.
Server-Sent Events stream of new turns as they arrive.
List what may wake the Fleet: its webhooks with their delivery URLs, its GitHub App subscriptions and its Slack mentions. No signing secret is returned.
Remove one of the Fleet's triggers; deliveries to it are refused from then on. Returns 204, also when it is already gone.
Read the caller tenant's credit-pool balance and exhaustion state.
List newest-first credit-pool charge telemetry rows for the caller tenant.

One bounded keyset page of the model catalogue, newest-updated date in `version`. Supports `limit`, `starting_after`, a `q` substring over model id and provider, and an exact `provider` filter. Carries an ETag; a matching If-None-Match answers 304. Follow `next_cursor` — the first page is not the whole catalogue.
One bounded keyset page of the caller tenant's own model registry. Follow `next_cursor` to read all of it.

Deliver an inbound event to the Fleet's webhook trigger whose source the URL names; this is the URL list_fleet_triggers shows for each webhook trigger. The body must be Hash-Based Message Authentication Code with Secure Hash Algorithm 256 (HMAC-SHA256) signed with the vault secret that trigger names (field webhook_secret); the provider-specific signature header is verified before the body is read. Idempotent within 24h via event_id.
Read complete-period settled totals, spending groups and daily spend for the caller tenant.
The runner holding a public fleet's run sends its query once. The platform calls Parallel Fast first and can use Exa as fallback. The body carries fencing_token, call_number and query.

The runner holding a public fleet's run requests one HTTPS page from the platform reader. The body carries fencing_token, call_number and url. Only a temporary reader problem with explicit permission allows one policy-checked local read.

revenue.description: Users may supply their own Large Language Model (LLM) API keys. agentsfleet meters hosted execution against a credit pool: event receipts are free, active runtime is $0.0001/sec under both postures, and platform-managed posture also adds provider token costs. New tenants receive a $5 starter credit. Usage lines retain recorded token counts, model price references and combined runtime/token charges.
